**16.2** Any amendment to this Agreement shall be identified by a sequential amendment number, shall state the date on which it becomes effective, and shall be annexed to this Agreement and form part of it. For the avoidance of doubt, an amendment that affects the payment schedule set out in Schedule 2 or the reporting obligations set out in Clauses 15 and 17 shall be subject to Clause 14.6 where applicable.

**16.3** Each party agrees to consider in good faith any request for an amendment proposed by the other party, provided that such request is made in writing and sets out the reasons for the proposed amendment and its anticipated effect on the Project.

**17. MONITORING, EVALUATION, AND AUDIT**

**17.1** The Recipient shall permit the Fund, or any person authorised by the Fund in writing, to inspect the Project sites, the Recipient’s premises, and all books, accounts, records, and other documents relating to the Project upon not less than five (5) business days’ written notice, during normal business hours, for the purpose of monitoring the Project and verifying compliance with this Agreement.

**17.2** The Recipient shall cooperate fully with any monitoring or evaluation exercise conducted by the Fund or its authorised representatives, including by making available relevant staff and providing such information as may reasonably be requested.

**17.3** The Fund may commission an independent evaluation of the Project at its own cost. The Recipient shall provide reasonable access and information to the evaluators and shall consider in good faith any recommendations arising from the evaluation.

**17.4** The Recipient shall maintain a complete and accurate record of all beneficiaries served by the Project, including the data fields specified in Schedule 4, and shall make such records available to the Fund upon request.

**18. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AND PUBLICITY**

**18.1** The Recipient shall own all intellectual property rights in any materials, content, or deliverables produced by the Recipient in the course of the Project, unless otherwise agreed in writing.

**18.3** The Recipient shall acknowledge the support of the Fund in all publications and public communications relating to the Project, using the acknowledgment wording set out in Schedule 5, unless the Fund directs otherwise in writing.

**18.4** The Recipient shall not use the Fund’s name or logo in any manner that implies endorsement of any commercial product, service, or political position without the Fund’s prior written consent.

**19. CONFIDENTIALITY**

**19.1** Each party shall keep confidential and shall not disclose to any third party any information of a confidential nature obtained from the other party in connection with this Agreement, including but not limited to the terms of this Agreement, financial information, and personal data of beneficiaries.

(a) is or becomes public knowledge other than through a breach of this Clause;
(b) is required to be disclosed by law, by any court of competent jurisdiction, or by any regulatory authority, provided that the disclosing party gives the other party prompt written notice where reasonably practicable;
(c) is disclosed to the disclosing party’s professional advisers or to the Fund’s auditors on a need-to-know basis; or

(b) Develop life skills, self-confidence, and creative expression among participating youth; and

(c) Foster community connections through public showcases and collaborations with local artists and organisations.

(a) is or becomes public knowledge other than through a breach of this Clause;
(b) is required to be disclosed by law, by any court of competent jurisdiction, or by any regulatory authority, provided that the disclosing party gives the other party prompt written notice where reasonably practicable;
